labels.label: def:singular_spacetime

hypotheses.note: unchanged by this target: the library's form of the definition is Causal.Causality.SingularFlatSpacetime (SingularFlatAxioms + connectedness, Causal.SingularGeroch), with no (G,X)-atlas; the witness is the model E₀ itself with singE0 (sing₀ = axis, sing_α = ∅ for α ≠ 0)

hypotheses.paper: endowed with the causality generated by its X_A-atlas and by the causalities of X and of the (X_α) (l.1502-1504)
hypotheses.note: the witness carries E0.causality, the curve causality of the model, under the readings of OQ-34 (flat extreme-BTZ metric through D, DEC-33's causal curves) and OQ-35; no atlas and no generated causality are formed (the abstraction has none)

hypotheses.paper: singular flat spacetime when A = ℝ₊ (l.1506)
hypotheses.note: sing α = ∅ for α > 0 is allowed, as on the timelike line (the abstraction does not model A); here sing₀ ≠ ∅ (singE0_zero_nonempty)

questions: Whether E₀ is a witness at all depends on OQ-34 (which E₀): the witness Causal.E0.singularFlatSpacetime is E₀ with the flat extreme-BTZ metric −2dτdr + dr² + r²dθ² entered through the developing map D, future causal curves read as DEC-33 reads them. Under the printed metric (l.1330) the singular line is timelike, I⁻(p) ≠ ∅ at its points and the BTZAxioms part of SingularFlatAxioms fails. Reading taken: OQ-34's, as in the strict Causal.Port.E0*; not decided here.

def:singular_spacetime (l.1501-1506) does not say whether an E^{1,2}_A-manifold must use every model X_α, α ∈ A, i.e. whether E₀ (only X_0 used, sing_α = ∅ for α > 0) is a 'singular flat spacetime' (A = ℝ₊) or only an E_{{0}}-spacetime. Reading taken: an atlas need not use every model, so E₀ is a singular flat spacetime; this is the reading the library's abstraction already makes (sing α may be empty; the timelike line, sing = ∅, was its only witness).

kb_proposals: E₀ satisfies SingularFlatAxioms and SingularFlatSpacetime (Causal.E0.singularFlatAxioms, singularFlatSpacetime, sing = Causal.E0.singE0, sing₀ = axis ≠ ∅; CausalScaffold.Port.E0SingularFlat, T-ett-port-e0-sfa); it is also strongly causal and globally hyperbolic (Causal.E0.stronglyCausal, globallyHyperbolic). Instantiate any theorem stated under SingularFlatAxioms there when a witness with a BTZ point is wanted (the timelike line has sing = ∅).

A gx → Causal port can be generated rather than copied: a script slices the gx file by line ranges into the port file between a hand-written head and tail, and the faithfulness check looks for each range as a contiguous verbatim block of the port (stronger than kb/0035's line-set check); 1724 lines of GX/BTZ/Causality.lean and LocalModel.lean compiled under namespace Causal with no change (T-ett-port-e0-sfa).

Model-free lemmas stranded under Causal.E0 / Causal.E0LM by the verbatim E₀ ports (kb/0047): SliceAt with pullback/pushforward, LocZplus…LocPastIn with rel_of_causallyConvex and locZplus_of/locZminus_of/locTarentin_of, the push-up link steps lt_of_lt_of_le_link / lt_of_le_link_of_lt, real induction prop_zero_of_down / prop_one_of_up; E0LM.pushUpOn_of_chartIso is a corollary of the strict Causal.ChartIso.pushUpOn. Hoist on demand, not in a port.
